petalMotion: The original petals use one monotonic Z translation between their fitted hull seat and a held open endpoint. No rotation, ship X displacement or later return stroke is applied.
seamFit: The complete outer skin of each source 26-vertex petal is fitted in Z to its actual adjoining stationary roof face. Original topology, UVs and X/Y footprints are retained; the previous 32 fixed lip edits remain unchanged.
packingClearance: Original bearing/tube groups pack 2.0 in Y and 0.30 in Z; fork guides retain a net 0.60 Y stroke. Petals use the squared center clock. The 0.25 passage allowance is baked into the held open endpoint, with no late descent.
petalMaterial: All eight petal skins share the actual Odin_Bridge_Armor material used by the adjoining roof.
